Brest.name: Julien Lachuer
Brest.bio_ko: Julien Lachuer is a French former professional footballer who played as a goalkeeper. He is currently the manager of Ligue 1 side Brest.

Paris FC.name: Antoine Kombouaré
Paris FC.bio_ko: 앙투안 크릴론 콩부아레(프랑스어: Antoine Krilone Kombouaré, 1963년 11월 16일 ~ )는 프랑스의 전 축구 선수이자 축구 감독이며, 포지션은 수비수이다. 누벨칼레도니 출신으로, 카나크인이다. 종종 경기 도중 중요한 순간에 헤딩으로 득점을 만들어내며 '황금 투구'라는 의미의 카스크 도르(Casque d'Or)라는 별명을 얻었다.

Strasbourg.name: Gary O'Neil
Strasbourg.bio_ko: Gary Paul O'Neil is an English football manager and former player, who is currently the manager of Premier League club Ipswich Town.

Rennes.name: Franck Haise
Rennes.bio_ko: Franck Armel Gérard Haise is a French professional football manager and former player who is currently the head coach of Ligue 1 club Rennes. As a player, he was a midfielder, spending most of his career in Ligue 2.
Rennes.tactics_ko: Haise has generally set up Lens in a 3-4-1-2 formation, although he has at times used a 3-5-2 and a 3-4-3. Despite mainly using a back three at Lens, he has stated, "I don’t have a favourite system.

Lille.name: Bruno Génésio
Lille.bio_ko: Bruno Génésio is a French football manager and former player who played as a midfielder. He is currently the head coach of Ligue 1 club Marseille.

Marseille.name: Habib Beye
Marseille.bio_ko: 하비브 프레데리크 베예(프랑스어: Habib Frédéric Beye, 1977년 10월 19일 ~ )는 세네갈의 전 프로 축구 선수로, 라이트백으로 활약했다. 그는 샹피오나 나시오날 클럽 레드 스타의 감독이였다.

Le Havre.name: Didier Digard
Le Havre.bio_ko: Didier Frédéric Thierry Digard is a French professional football manager and former player who is the head coach of Le Havre. As a player, he was a defensive midfielder.

Metz.name: Benoît Tavenot
Metz.bio_ko: Benoît Tavenot is a French football manager and former player.

Nantes.name: Vahid Halilhodžić
Nantes.bio_ko: Vahid Halilhodžić is a Bosnian former professional football manager and former player. He is regarded as one of the most controversially successful Bosnian football managers, due to his successful tenure in coaching various national teams yet having problematic relations with his teams and players due to different approaches.

PSG.name: Luis Enrique
PSG.bio_ko: 루이스 엔리케 마르티네스 가르시아(스페인어: Luis Enrique Martínez García, 스페인어 발음: [lwis enˈrike maɾˈtineθ ɡaɾˈθia]; 1970년 5월 8일 ~ )는 루이스 엔리케라는 약칭으로도 알려져 있는 스페인의 축구 감독이자 전(前) 축구 선수이다. 현재 프랑스 리그 1의 파리 생제르맹 감독을 맡고 있다.
PSG.tactics_ko: In his first two seasons at the Camp Nou, Luis Enrique fielded a 4-3-3 formation . Results improved after he stopped changing his starting eleven.

Angers.name: Alexandre Dujeux
Angers.bio_ko: Alexandre Dujeux is a French professional football coach and a former defender. He is currently the manager of Ligue 1 club Lorient.

Toulouse.name: Carles Martínez Novell
Toulouse.bio_ko: Carles Martínez Novell is a Spanish football manager and former player who is currently head coach of Bundesliga club Bayer Leverkusen.

Lyon.name: Paulo Fonseca
Lyon.bio_ko: 파울루 알레샨드르 호드리게스 폰세카(포르투갈어: Paulo Alexandre Rodrigues Fonseca, 1973년 3월 5일~)는 모잠비크 출신 포르투갈의 축구 선수, 감독이다. 선수 시절 포지션은 센터백이며 현재 프랑스 리그 1 축구단인 올랭피크 리옹의 감독을 맡고 있다.
Lyon.tactics_ko: At Shakhtar, Roma and Lille, Fonseca preferred a 4-2-3-1 formation and an emphasis on dominating possession. In these teams, the player behind the centre-forward played as a second striker ; Henrikh Mkhitaryan achieved 13 goals for Roma in 2020-21 from that position.

Auxerre.bio_ko:

Christophe Pélissier (footballer), French manager and former footballer

Monaco.name: Sébastien Pocognoli
Monaco.bio_ko: Sébastien Jean Pocognoli is a Belgian football coach and former player who is the head coach of the Scotland national team.

Lorient.name: Olivier Pantaloni
Lorient.bio_ko: Olivier Pantaloni is a French football manager and former player. He is the current head coach of Ligue 1 club Nice.
